failure: A graceful request was stored as CANCELED while Temporal remained RUNNING with no worker. The terminal record hid Force cancel and made the service return without terminating the execution.
requiredEvidence: Authenticated HTTP force cancellation terminates parent and child without a workflow worker and persists terminal state across reconciliation and retries.

An already completed run keeps its actual outcome and a reused workflow ID is not terminated.
